rules.title: Ban on nonrefundable security deposits
rules.requirement: A lease or rental agreement may not contain a provision calling any security deposit nonrefundable.
rules.coverage_text: Leases and rental agreements subject to this section.
rules.quoted_span: A lease or rental agreement shall not contain a provision characterizing any security as “nonrefundable.”

rules.title: Bad faith retention of security deposit damages
rules.requirement: A landlord or successor in interest who in bad faith claims or retains the security in violation of this section, or in bad faith demands replacement security in violation of subdivision (k), may be liable for statutory damages of up to twice the amount of the security plus actual damages.
rules.key_value: statutory damages of up to twice the amount of the security, in addition to actual damages
rules.coverage_text: Landlords and landlords' successors in interest holding a tenant's security.
rules.penalty: Statutory damages of up to twice the amount of the security, in addition to actual damages; the landlord bears the burden of proof as to the reasonableness of amounts claimed.
rules.quoted_span: The bad faith claim or retention by a landlord or the landlord’s successors in interest of the security or any portion thereof in violation of this section, or the bad faith demand of replacement of security in violation of subdivision (k), may subject the landlord or the landlord’s successors in interest to statutory damages of up to twice the amount of the security, in addition to actual damages.

rules.title: Handling of security deposit on termination of landlord's interest
rules.requirement: When the landlord's interest in the premises ends, the landlord or agent must within a reasonable time either transfer the remaining security to the successor in interest and notify the tenant, or return the remaining security to the tenant with an accounting.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords whose interest in the premises terminates by sale, assignment, death, appointment of receiver, or otherwise.
rules.penalty: In the event of noncompliance with subdivision (i), the landlord's successors in interest are jointly and severally liable with the landlord for repayment of the security.

rules.title: Written statement of security to successor before voluntary transfer
rules.requirement: Before voluntarily transferring an interest in the premises, the landlord must give the successor in interest a written statement of the remaining security, an itemization of lawful deductions, and the landlord's election under subdivision (i).
rules.coverage_text: Landlords voluntarily transferring their interest in the premises.
